body: Founder: 'his kit was stubbed in' -> 'clones multi control drag click all of it' -> 'divided we stand rework.' Two gaps: (1) clones were NEVER synced to any client at all (hero-chunk system only covered real player slots) -- fixed with is_clone/clone_owner + widened chunk range + dedicated clone draw pass. (2) clones auto-mirrored Tyler instead of true Meepo-style independent control -- removed, added arena_owner_controls authorization + widened move/attack commands + real RTS drag-select client-side. Bot pool senders updated too. Full suite green (814 assertions), build clean.
title: Tyler Divided We Stand rework: real clone control + fixed a visibility bug
